protocol.purpose: Reverse then forward ranking, three distinct caps, two independent fresh loads each, six requests per load; identical controls. Both screening stages excluded from confirmation estimates.
protocol.selection_rule: Fresh refinement remeasurement supersedes coarse measurement of same cap for selection; preserved raw coarse data. Other caps use coarse. No pooling unequal screening repetition counts.
protocol.checks: Correct retrieval, cache0,swap0, expert work and copy-byte counters; stop on any failure and restore selected2K.
protocol.limits: Only two confirmation loads per cap, conditional winner selection and short deterministic generations. No default change without review and numerical checks.

scope: Completed independent six-load confirmation. Both screening stages excluded.
